title: Phase 17.1 Causal Ablation of Meta Muse Reasoning & CASM Scientific Memory

results.notes: Searches through topologies blind to chord locking; succeeds after 10 calls.

causal_finding: 1. Cold Muse (Zero Memory) completely fails on heavy-load tasks (0% feasible yield) because it defaults to classic fixed-guided flexures vulnerable to chord locking. 2. CASM scientific memory provides a decisive causal benefit over Cold Muse (100% vs 0% yield). 3. Discovered scaling laws accelerate Classical search by 60% (10 -> 4 calls), while CASM counterexample pruning achieves the fastest convergence (2 calls).
